about_the_game:
This DLC is a high-definition art asset pack for the game "Ultimate Girl Artemis", including:

Illustrations of the main characters' clothing, including five female protagonists (including formal wear, casual wear, combat wear, etc.)

Illustration and three-view drawing of the protagonist group and BOSS battle leather case

HD proportional CG and Q version handbook CG

The original video for the game's dynamic wallpaper on the Wallpaper Engine

HD chibi style illustrations and emojis

Distribution of Vrchat models of the Q-version main cast and proportional PMX models of Mitsuki

Attention: The file will be downloaded to the game installation directory. You can right-click on the game name in the STEAM game list, select "Properties" - "Installed Files" - "Browse" or "Manage" - "Browse Local Files" to open the game directory.

content_descriptors.notes:
This DLC contains Mature Content : some Nudity content,including some revealing outfits.
This DLC does not contain the following elements: sexual behavior or sexual assault, extreme violence or  blood
